title: Create a 15 second advert for this shirt product "@ Image", start the video by…
content: Create a 15 second advert for this shirt product "@ Image", start the video by following the stitching and sewing of it and then transition into an epic upbeat video of the shirt being worn at a nightclub, lots of slow motion.
